name: wash4u
description: A redesigned static website for **Wash4You** (`https://wash4you.in/`) inspired by the UI/UX of [Rinse.com](https://www.rinse.com/), with all original content preserved.

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:deps && python3 src/build.py
scripts.build:deps: pip3 install -r requirements.txt || pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt || pip3 install --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt
scripts.build:js: esbuild src/js/main.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=es2019 --legal-comments=none --banner:js='/* GENERATED FILE — do not edit. Source: src/js/  •  Rebuild: npm run build:js */' --outfile=src/assets/js/main.js
